description: Port universe + inland yards for Maersk (MSK). Keys from msk_yards.geojson (CityYard). type is port (v3 secondary-scrape target) or inland (v3 main scrape). v3 = scrape inland, derive ports, secondary-scrape missing ports (see /synth.md). READ-ONLY: v3 only reads type. NOTES / verify-after-first-run: (1) Long Beach and Seattle are NOT in the yard set, so they are never queried; MSK.normalize_pod keeps Los Angeles/Long Beach and Seattle/Tacoma distinct, so any Long Beach/Seattle voyages appear only as derive-only distinct discharge ports (like HPL Long Beach). (2) The NY/NJ port is keyed here as Newark, NJ (the yard name), but utils.PORT_NAMES normalizes the discharge facility to New York, NY — confirm the derived port_of_discharge name matches the coverage key so the missing-ports diff lines up. Fort Worth, TX has no Maersk city code and is skipped automatically.
